question: A solid cylindrical conductor of length L and radius R carries current along its axis as shown in the figure. The resistivity of the material is not uniform and varies with radial distance r from the central axis as ρ(r) = ρ0 (r/R), where ρ0 is a constant (so ρ = ρ0 at the surface r = R). Treat the conductor as made of many thin coaxial cylindrical shells of thickness dr (each shell has cross-sectional area 2πrdr) which are connected in parallel for the axial current. determine the equivalent resistance Req of the wire.
